trustSafety.heading: We know what you're worried about.
trustSafety.subheading: You may have already heard stories like these:
trustSafety.description: Fake job listings, hidden fees that only appear after payment, promises that vanish after a transfer. RedBridge exists to draw a clear line against these practices. Our word is our bond — and you're welcome to verify it yourself.

userScenario.eyebrow: What kind of help do you need most right now?

scenarios.title: I just graduated
scenarios.description: I have an Australian degree, but I do not yet have enough local work experience to apply for migration.

scenarios.title: I need visa sponsorship
scenarios.description: I am a skilled professional or I have work experience, and I am looking for an Australian employer who can sponsor my 482 or 186 visa.

scenarios.title: I want permanent residency
scenarios.description: I want to apply for PR independently through the points-tested skilled migration system.

scenarios.title: My visa is about to expire
scenarios.description: I am short on time and need urgent guidance on bridging visas, visa extensions, or changing visa types.
